title: Correlation immunity of the junta witness core
statement: Let $r$ and $d$ be nonnegative integers, let $g$ be a Boolean function on the $r$-dimensional sign cube, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates. Suppose that $g$ depends only on coordinates in $J$ and is correlation immune through degree $d$, meaning that every nonempty Fourier coefficient indexed by a set of at most $d$ coordinates is zero. Then the function on the $|J|$-dimensional sign cube obtained by restricting the coordinates outside $J$ to $+1$ and reindexing the coordinates in $J$ is also correlation immune through degree $d$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on the $r$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the $r$ coordinates
